name: yak-tree
description: A Claude Code mod that keeps a tree of what you are working on in a side pane, using done / here / important marks

issueKeyPattern.title: Issue key pattern
issueKeyPattern.description: Regular expression that pulls an issue key out of the git branch name, such as ^([A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+)(/|$). A branch that matches gets one tree per issue. Leave empty to use one tree per branch.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the text yak-tree shows: the pane heading and the error messages of its tools.

view.title: View
view.description: How the pane draws the tree: e is an outline, a is a git-graph style. /tree e or /tree a changes it and is remembered across sessions; the remembered choice wins over this setting.

warnAfterToolCalls.title: Warn after this many tool calls
warnAfterToolCalls.description: (Not implemented yet.) When a turn runs this many tool calls without updating the tree, a one-line warning appears under the answer.
